title: The same number twice
prompt: This finds the center of a grid tile, and the tile size 64 appears twice. Name it once as `TILE_SIZE` and use the name in both places, so changing the tile size later takes one edit.
hints: `TILE_SIZE * column + TILE_SIZE / 2`; the judge checks 64 appears only once.

docs.name: const NAME = value
docs.what: Declares a named value that never changes. Written in CAPITALS by convention.
